prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Newlyweds aged 28 and 33 walk hand in hand through a small group of adult guests tossing pale paper confetti outside a wedding ceremony. The bride laughs while the groom looks warmly toward her. Keep the couple together as the main focus and guests secondary. Use clean afternoon daylight and a spontaneous action photograph. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The bride has a chin-length dark curly bob, light olive skin and a broad friendly face. The groom is a fair-skinned redhead with short straight hair, freckles, and no beard. Make them distinct from any other wedding images. Exact horizontal 16:9. Use a genuinely wide environmental view: the couple and their full important gestures inside central 55 percent of width, open venue space at both edges, background guests secondary and unobtrusive.
review: Reviewed wide image: curly-dark-haired bride and freckled red-haired groom walking under paper confetti, with distinct adult guests on either side. Joined hands and bouquet are coherent; couple fits the central crop, secondary guests occupy edges, no visible lettering.
